protocol.null: labels permuted over all wafers (class balance preserved exactly: 104 fails / 1,463 passes); X untouched. Every sensor reported under this null is a false discovery by construction.
protocol.real_arm: identical loop, true labels, random_state varied per replicate so both arms are distributions over the loop's internal randomness
protocol.fit_on: all 1,567 wafers (this measures what the loop *reports*, not what it predicts; no held-out scoring is involved)
protocol.threshold: tau(alpha) = (1-alpha) quantile of the null max_stability; Westfall-Young max-statistic control, family-wise over the sensors screened per replicate

null_fdr.definition: every sensor reported on a permuted-label replicate is false, so FDR = (reported on null) / (reported on null) = 1.0 whenever anything is reported at all. The informative quantity is the abstention rate.
